text: {"standards":[{"code":"RL.6.1","verdict":"taught","reason":"Part A has students reread pp. 107–116, chart training episodes with page-numbered quotes, and state what each shows about Percy's skills and relationships, which matches citing textual evidence for explicit and inferred meaning."},{"code":"RL.6.5","verdict":"taught","reason":"Part B has students order the training episodes on a sequence strip and explain what each adds that the next one needs, so they analyze how the sequence fits the chapter's structure and builds toward capture the flag and the quest."},{"code":"L.6.4","verdict":"partly","reason":"The Context Clue Hunt has students determine meanings of pulverize and appraised from context, but the other eight words are deferred to later reading, and the Break It Down syllabication work is decoding rather than determining meaning."},{"code":"L.6.6","verdict":"partly","reason":"Vocabulary is introduced and used in the Quick Write and Part B, but students mainly restate the given definitions and do not gather or apply domain-specific word knowledge across the passage beyond a few words."}],"anchorText":{"verdict":"uses","reason":"The Context Clue Hunt, Part A, and Part B all direct students to pp. 107–116 of The Lightning Thief, matching the outlined pages and the focus on Percy's training episodes."}}
